text:
jason_sales: Handoff: Solstice Health signed a 3-month pilot (PO done). Primary asks: HIPAA-safe private control plane, SAML SSO, audit logs, low-latency during clinic hours. Go-live target 2025-06-02. Expected baseline ~10k tokens/day, peak ~6 concurrent sessions. Owner @leah_cs for onboarding. Customer contact: sara@solstice.health. Docs: https://solstice.example/handshake

leah_cs: Thanks — I'll take this. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Will they require dedicated GPUs or is private control plane enough? 2) Any mandatory SIEM integration?

jason_sales: They prefer private control plane but are ok with a dedicated pool if latency needs it. SIEM: Splunk forward of audit logs preferred.

rachel_support: Creating infra ticket now. Need SAML metadata, customer VPC CIDR for peering, and Splunk endpoint details. ETA to provision: 2-4 business days after we have artifacts.

miko_eng: FYI: to keep p99 <250ms under 6 concurrent sessions we should be fine with private control plane if we use a warmed dedicated pool in the peak window. If they want auto-scale, price will rise ~15%. Need avg tokens/session to size KV cache.

jason_sales: Avg tokens/session ~700, sessions concentrated 8am-2pm PT.

leah_cs: Action owners (writing down): CS: leah_cs (onboarding, customer comms), Support: rachel_support (infra tickets & provisioning), Eng: miko_eng (capacity, perf sims), Security: chris_security (BAA/DPA review + Splunk ingestion), Sales: jason_sales (contract questions).

chris_security: Send me their BAA/DPA and any questionnaire. We will require HSM-backed key storage for customer keys — adds ~3 business days to setup. Also need to confirm logging retention policy.

onboard-bot: ticket CS-2042 created by rachel_support - infra.provision.privateplane

leah_cs: Checklist to share with customer:
```
- SAML metadata (IdP XML)
- VPC CIDR + peering contact
- Splunk HEC endpoint + token (if required)
- Signed BAA (scan to security@redwood.com)
- Eval prompt set (~50 prompts)
- Canary plan (10% traffic -> 50% -> full)
```

rachel_support: Scheduling tech kickoff Wed 2025-05-21 10:00am PT. Placeholder sent. Please add any internal prerequisites to the ticket.

miko_eng: I'll run a perf sim once we get their eval set. Plan: q4 quant + kv cache enabled, verify quality delta on eval set. If quality drops >2% on key prompts, recommend non-quant variant for canary.

jason_sales: Renewal risk: low-to-medium. Pilot may expand to full deployment after clinical validation. Major blockers: security/legal delays and any sustained latency incidents. I'll keep customer expectations aligned.

leah_cs: I'm adding a weekly health sync every Wednesday until pilot ends. If any infra/security blocker pushes >7 business days, escalate to Head of CS and CRO.

chris_security: Noted. Also request for Splunk ingestion will need an allowlist entry from their network team — please get contact info in kickoff.
